item.title: happy birthday to my favorite human. some people spend their whole lives looking for someone who truly gets them. i was lucky enough to be born with m...
item.description: happy birthday to my favorite human. some people spend their whole lives looking for someone who truly gets them. i was lucky enough to be born with mine. what we have is so rare. there’s something so comforting about always knowing you’ll be there. and i’ll be forever grateful for it. there isn’t a day that goes by without us talking, laughing, working, dreaming… simply sharing life together. no one makes me feel more at home than you do. no matter where we are in the world, as long as you are there, everything feels familiar. happy birthday Lenthie. here’s to everything we’ve already lived, and to everything that’s still waiting for us. i love you more than you’ll ever know
